purpose: Capture exact returned text fragments as audit sources, including incidental text absent from material annotations. Recording a source never establishes lemma identity, complete semantic coverage or novelty.

semantics.records: Distinct exact string values from returned JSON payloads, before delivery, under the authenticated student ID.
semantics.preserves: Original spelling, accents, case, options, hints, corrections and actual response text present in the delivered payload.
semantics.doesNotInfer: Lemmas, sentence boundaries, unheard audio transcription, outside-app familiarity or semantic completeness.
semantics.deduplication: Student, server-owned boundary and ordered text-fragment checksum; numeric clock ticks do not duplicate unchanged text.
semantics.failure: Storage errors withhold delivery. Missing pre-migration RPC retains existing behavior without claiming capture; coverage remains disabled.
semantics.coverage: Unverified journal writes invalidate later coverage, preserving immutable earlier presentation proofs.
semantics.access: No anonymous/authenticated direct access; service role can read but cannot overwrite records. Only the server recorder writes.
semantics.excludes: Transport URLs, including signed audio URLs and access tokens. Audio bytes and transcript coverage require separate verification.

remainingBeforeActivation: Audit all student routes/actions, including client-bundled educational content, static reference text, production/repair pages and alternate legacy response paths.
Account for audio bytes and authoritative transcripts separately; a signed URL does not certify heard material.
Build verified semantic capture from source text to reviewed word/lemma, sentence and audio identities. Partial annotations and raw snapshots remain unverified.
Verify content-boundary invalidation and capture through a deployed fresh-account journey, then enable the capture contract only after that contract is complete.
Keep older students unverified until audited historical reconstruction is available; never relabel prior observations.
